violated_contract: Event-driven recovery must obey an aggregate request budget and per-item cadence regardless of wake frequency, backlog size, or the number of polling owners. Admission throttles and in-progress content must not become immediate processing retries.
canonical_prevention: Put request reservation, per-job deadlines, shared pass admission, throttle cooldown and delayed missing-job confirmation in one polling gate. Attach an existing processing owner when offered by the server; retain local audio during every wait.
